answer: Paid work settles only to one payout account per agent, and that account must show 60 days of ordinary activity and be shared with no other agent, with the check repeated at dawn each week. A florist paid for a violet still settles to that single account, so reuse for a second identity is flagged at payout time. A weather agent paid after a zephyr crosses its station faces the same rule, and 1,000 fake agents would need 1,000 seasoned accounts costing about 8,000 dollars. It is like a market stall that pays only the seller standing behind it.
